newsitem.title: NORWAY: Nycomed seeks authorisation for share issu.
newsitem.headline: Nycomed seeks authorisation for share issu.

text.p: Norwegian pharmaceuticals group Nycomed ASA said on Monday the board would propose to shareholders to authorise the issue of 5,123,689 news shares to increase the company's share capital by up to 20.5 billion crowns.
Each share would have a nominal value of four crowns with proportional increase of each class of share, according to a statement from the company.
The board will put its proposal to shareholders at the annual ordinary general meeting on Tuesday at 1400 GMT.

Nycomed said gains from the authorisation would be used in connection with acquisition of or merger with other companies, and the purchase of businesses, buildings, properties and shares of particular interest to the company.
